**Published online:**
2026-08-27

**Geographic focus:**
North America, United States (Farm Belt, rural America)

**Temporal focus:**
T1. Historical observation [NO]
T2. Forward-looking immediate [YES]
T3. Long-term development [YES]

**Synopsis:**
The Trump administration is considering roughly doubling small refinery exemptions (SREs) under the Renewable Fuel Standard — from ~990M to ~1.8B RINs — for the 2025 compliance year, motivated by gasoline price pressures amid the Iran war. Farm and biofuel coalitions are pushing back hard, warning of collapsed biofuel demand and reduced corn/soybean consumption. A parallel plan to restore exempted volumes in future RVO quotas is under discussion but lacks clarity. A decision is expected before end of August.
